title.en: New models: Gemini 3.7 Flash, GLM 5.3, Grok 4.6, Grok Imagine, GPT Image 2

summary.en: Seven new models across text, image and video are available on OmniMux.
summary.zh: 文本、图像与视频共七个新模型现已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## New models

Seven new models are now available on OmniMux, synced from the latest upstream catalog.

### Text

- **Model IDs:** `gemini-3.7-flash`, `glm-5.3`, `grok-4.6`
- **API:** OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions at `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`

### Image

- **Model IDs:** `grok-imagine-image`, `grok-imagine-image-quality`, `gpt-image-2`
- **API:** `POST /v1/images/generations`

### Video

- **Model IDs:** `grok-imagine-video`
- **API:** `POST` / `GET` `/v1/video/generations`

See the model pages for parameters, pricing and task polling.
body.zh:
## 新模型

七个新模型现已在 OmniMux 可调用，已同步最新上游目录。

### 文本

- **模型 ID：** `gemini-3.7-flash`、`glm-5.3`、`grok-4.6`
- **API：** OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions：`https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`

### 图像

- **模型 ID：** `grok-imagine-image`、`grok-imagine-image-quality`、`gpt-image-2`
- **API：** `POST /v1/images/generations`

### 视频

- **模型 ID：** `grok-imagine-video`
- **API：** `POST` / `GET` `/v1/video/generations`

参数、定价与任务轮询见各模型页。
